title: POS terminal down (F&B / front desk)
description: A point-of-sale terminal cannot take orders or payments (F&B, bar, banquet, front desk checkout).
problemDescription: Máy POS bị lỗi. POS terminal frozen, cannot connect, payment declined, printer off.
prerequisites: Employee is at the POS terminal
Employee can see the terminal screen
expectedResult: POS is back online and can take orders/payments.
failureCondition: After all steps the POS still cannot operate.
escalationCondition: Suspected network/hardware fault or steps exhausted without resolution.

steps.instruction: Is the terminal powered on and the screen responsive (not frozen)?
Hold the power button to restart the terminal. After reboot, is it responsive?
Can the terminal reach the network / POS server? (Check for 'offline' banner or connection error.)
Check the network cable / Wi-Fi and the nearest switch. Restart the terminal network if needed, then retry.
Can you open a new order and add an item?
Try a test payment (or the guest's payment). Is it accepted?
Restart the POS app (or the payment terminal) and sign back in. Does it work now?
Great — the POS is operational again. Continue the order.
